## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] `go build ./...` passes / 通过
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes (or `make test`) / 通过
- [ ] `golangci-lint run` is clean / 无告警

- [ ] Docs / comments updated where relevant / 相关文档与注释已更新
